messages:
Alex: heads-up — ran into a noisy default in the SLO editor. default notify toggled ON for all thresholds; small tenants getting flooded with low-severity alerts. can we flip the default or make it less aggressive?
Katie: saw this in two customers today. agreed — default ON is surprising. maybe default to off and surface a 'enable notifications' step in the wizard.
Samir: telemetry: after last rollout (slo-editor-v3) we saw a 27% bump in low/sev=info alerts. quick query: `SELECT count(*) FROM alerts WHERE severity='low' AND created_at > now() - interval '7 days'` — noise concentrated in routes with <100 req/day.
Lina: API compatibility note: customers are reading `notify_policy` from GET /slo. if we change server-side default we need to avoid silently changing returned object unless user explicitly opted in. versioned behavior or feature flag?
Ben: UX idea: show an "alerting preview" in the editor that runs the policy against 7d telemetry and returns an estimated noise score + sample alerts. tiny mock: ```json
{"preview": {"estimated_alerts_per_day": 42, "top_routes": ["/v1/generate","/embed"]}}
```
Alex: propose a small config model change — add `notify_mode` enum: `explicit` | `inherited` | `disabled`. server default remains `inherited` but UI can require explicit opt-in during new SLO creation. sample server-sensible snippet: ```json
{"slo_id": "s-123", "threshold": 0.99, "notify_mode": "explicit"}```
Samir: routing note — we also need to clarify precedence in docs: route-level notify overrides tenant default, which overrides org/global default. Otherwise the console shows the wrong effective policy.
Katie: also want to expose a per-tenant quieting quota: if a tenant triggers >X low sev alerts/day, automatically suppress low-sev until they acknowledge. reduces noisy churn.
Lina: agree on doc + API contract. my ask: we don't change the field shape; introduce `notify_mode` as additive and gated by FF. rollout plan: feature-flag -> console opt-in -> gradual canary -> flip default for new SLOs only.
deploy-bot: :rocket: Canary rollout started: slo-notify-defaults -> 5% traffic -> started by deploy pipeline at 2024-06-21T14:02Z
Ben: can we add a telemetry signal for "predicted_noise" to the SLO telemetry index so the preview doesn't re-run heavy queries? compute nightly and store.
Samir: good. add an API endpoint GET /slo/:id/preview that returns the stored prediction and a small sample. fallback to on-demand only if missing.
Alex: i'll open a quick RFC that covers: API additive field, console preview wireframe, telemetry metric, and rollout FF. will assign owners.
Katie: thanks — can you also include messaging for Enterprise docs (Dedicated/Private) about default behavior and how they can pin notify policy?
Lina: i'll review the RFC for API compatibility. if folks agree, i'll implement FF gating on the backend.
Ben: i'll mock the UI changes and put them in Figma, link in RFC.
Alex: created ticket and RFC draft: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/INFR-1427 — please add comments. planning PR for backend + canary next week.
Samir: ack, i'll wire the telemetry job and add the `predicted_noise` column.
Katie: +1. thanks team. this should cut a lot of churn. :thumbsup:
